questions.question: ______ transfers the ink through a set of small pins arranged in the form of matrix.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Dot Matrix printer.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **A dot matrix printer i**s an impact printer that prints using a fixed number of pins or wires.
 
• Typically the pins or wires are arranged in one or several vertical columns.
 
• The pins strike an ink-coated ribbon and force contact between the ribbon and the paper, so that each pin makes a small dot on the paper.

 [IMAGE: https://3.imimg.com/data3/PE/WT/MY-11069583/dot-matrix-printer-250x250.jpg] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Laser printing** is an electrostatic digital printing process. It produces high-quality text and graphics (and moderate-quality photographs) by repeatedly passing a laser beam back and forth over a negatively-charged cylinder called a "drum" to define a differentially-charged image.
 
• The drum then selectively collects electrically-charged powdered ink (toner), and transfers the image to paper, which is then heated to permanently fuse the text, imagery, or both, to the paper.

 [IMAGE: https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/61ZHm0eqeEL._AC_SX355_.jpg] 

 
• **3D printing or additive manufacturing** is the construction of a three-dimensional object from a CAD model or a digital 3D model.
 
• It can be done in a variety of processes in which material is deposited, joined or solidified under computer control, with material being added together (such as plastics, liquids or powder grains being fused), typically layer by layer.

questions.question: Which of the following Schedules of the Constitution of India embodies three lists: Union, State and Concurrent?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Seventh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__**Seventh Schedule **__

__
 
• The Seventh Schedule to the constitution provides **three lists** for the distribution of legislative subjects between the **Centre and the State.**
 
• Division of powers between the Union and the States in terms of **List 1 (Union List), List 2 (State List), and List 3 (Concurrent List)**.
 
 
• **List 1 (Union List):__**
 __
 
• **​__**The Parliament has exclusive power to make laws with respect to any of the subjects enumerated in the Union List.
 
• At present, the **Union List has 100 subjects (originally 97).**
 
• The important subjects are **Defence, External Affairs, Railways, Highways, Lotteries, Corporation tax, Census, Income Tax, Post office.**
 
 
 
• __**List 2 (State List):**__
 __
 
• **​**__The State legislatures have, in normal circumstances, exclusive powers to make laws with respect to any of the subjects enumerated in the State List.
 
• At present, the **State List has 61 subjects (originally 66).**
 
• The important subjects are** Police, Local Self Government, Public Health and Sanitation, Agriculture, Fisheries, Taxes on agricultural income.**
 
 
 
• __**List 3 (Concurrent List):**__
 __
 
• Both the Parliament and the State legislatures can make laws with respect to any of the subjects enumerated in the Concurrent List.
 
• At present, the **Concurrent List has 52 subjects (originally 47).**
 
• The important subjects are **Education, Electricity, Forests, Protection of Wild Animals, Population Control and family planning, Price control, Marriage and divorce.****​**
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__**Second Schedule**__

__
 
• The Second Schedule to the constitution provides the** salary and emoluments, allowances, privileges** of:
 
• **The President, The Governors of States, The Speaker, and the Deputy Speaker of the Lok Sabha, The Chairman and the Deputy Chairman of the Rajya Sabha, The Speaker, and the Deputy Speaker of the Legislative Assembly in the States, The Chairman and the Deputy Chairman of the Legislative Council of the States, The Judges of the Supreme Court and High Court, Comptroller Auditor General of India.**

**Ninth Schedule**__

__
 
• **Acts and Regulations** of the state legislatures dealing with land reforms and the abolition of the** Zamindari system and of the Parliament dealing with the others.**
 
• This schedule was added by the** 1st Amendment Act 1951** to protect the laws included in it from judicial scrutiny on the grounds of violation of fundamental rights.

**Sixth Schedule**__

__
 
• Provisions related to the administration of tribal areas in the states of **Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, and Mizoram.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Article 246** - The Seventh Schedule to the constitution provides three lists for the distribution of legislative subjects between the Centre and the State.
 
• The idea of the** Union List and State list** was borrowed from the **Canadian Constitution.**
 
• The idea of the** Concurrent list **was borrowed from the **Australian** Constitution.

• It flows through the eastern part of the Tibet Autonomous Region and Yunnan province, after which it forms part of the international border between **Myanmar (Burma) and Laos, as well as between Laos and Thailand.**
 
• About three-fourths of the drainage area of the Mekong lies within the four countries the river traverses on its lower course—**Laos, Thailand, Cambodia, and Vietnam.**

• The principle of gender equality is enshrined in the Indian Constitution under the Preamble, Fundamental Rights, Directive Principles of State Policy, and Fundamental Duties.
